messages:
nina: Heads-up: we're rolling out a new dedicated inference class in APAC-SG (mi450, 48GB, mixed-precision tuned) next week. Target region window starts Thu May 12 02:00 UTC.
nina: This is intended for inference-heavy customers that want lower tail latency for long-context workloads. Pools: `mi450-sg-primary` and `mi450-sg-burst`.
josh: How are we sequencing zones?
keiko: Staggered by availability zone: sg-1a -> sg-1c -> sg-1b to match partner preview commitments. We'll do ~18 nodes per zone initially, with a +12 burst buffer.
sre-bot: NOTE: No scheduled tenant VM downtime expected; rolling infra updates only. Observability flags will be enabled for the first 72h.
leo: Important: this SKU is inference-only; training workloads should be blocked by quota during rollout. Please add a soft deny in the quotas service.
keiko: Routing policy: default for new requests will prefer mi450 where customer capacity allows. Customers with hard pins to older families will continue to route to their pinned pools unless they opt-in to migrate.
josh: Billing / pricing?
finance-bot: mi450-dedicated rate set to a preview price. We'll publish final rates after partner preview concludes. Existing reserved customers who opt to switch will get prorated credits.
support-bot: Support playbook drafted. Tag infra tickets with `mi450-rollout`. Escalation: @keiko -> @josh -> platform on-call. Canned answer ready for common CS questions.
keiko: Telemetry to watch: per-model latency P50/P95, GPU mem headroom, KV-cache hit rate, and early preemption signals. We'll enable an experimental sampler for traces on 10% of requests.
nina: Partner preview next Wed (May 11) 20:00-23:00 UTC in sg-1a for 3 partners. If preview goes green, full rollout to sg-1a starts May 12 02:00 UTC.
leo: Ops note: we'll tag all nodes with `mi450-preview` during partner window so we can easily rollback.
josh: Are there special migration commands for customers?
keiko: Migration snippets will go into the internal docs:
```
rwctl pools list --region apac-sg --filter gpu=mi450
rwctl reservations migrate --from-pool legacy-sg --to-pool mi450-sg-primary --customer <id>
```
nina: Please avoid scheduling major releases that depend on dedicated pools in APAC-SG during rollout window.
sre-bot: SCHEDULED: mi450 APAC-SG rollout starting 2039913600. Maintenance window per zone ends 2039999999.
josh: Thanks all, looks good. I'll sync with Sales for partner comms.
keiko: I'll post a short post-rollout perf summary with token-level P95 and cost-per-token comparisons.
leo: :rocket: thanks team, will follow-up with quota changes.
nina: Will post a final announcement to #customers when sg-1a is live. Ping me if you need a customer whitelist for early access.
